limitations: Exact arithmetic, one scalar least-squares coordinate and two equally sampled, contradictory observations.
One correction row and an independent, with-replacement validation sample; unconstrained one-level Armijo backtracking only.
One-step false acceptance is not a global convergence theorem; predicted expected ascent is of order one over validation size.
No claim about the margin-corrected sufficient-decrease test or finite precision.
scientific_integrity: Analytical binomial and central-limit proofs; exact-fraction finite cross-checks; earlier recognition of noisy uphill steps is credited. Same-model assessment only, without independent audit.
title: A square-root validation/backtracking frontier for sampled Armijo acceptance at a least-squares optimum
